answer: Agents can require each new identity to post a bond that is slashed if its messages are caught violating a challenge rule, while rewards accrue only after independent peers validate useful work. A sybil operator can mirror legitimate behavior across many accounts, but must lock capital in every bond and expose each account to costly review; splitting one agent into a river of aliases therefore multiplies the stake at risk, not its influence. A haven for honest newcomers is a small, refundable bond paired with strict limits on unvalidated reach.
